#check_failure Roth.degreeOf_uniqueAlgEquiv_symm
namespace UniqueDegree162Composition
open MvPolynomial
variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {σ : Type*} [Unique σ]
theorem directGenericLaw (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    degreeOf default p =
      (optionEquivLeft R {b : σ // b ≠ default}
        (rename (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe (default : σ)).symm p)).natDegree := by
  classical
  exact degreeOf_eq_natDegree default p
theorem representationGap (f : Polynomial R) : True := by
  classical
  have checked : degreeOf default ((uniqueAlgEquiv R σ).symm f) = f.natDegree → True :=
    fun _ ↦ True.intro
  fail_if_success
    apply checked
    exact degreeOf_eq_natDegree default ((uniqueAlgEquiv R σ).symm f)
  fail_if_success
    apply checked
    simpa only [uniqueAlgEquiv_symm_apply] using
      degreeOf_eq_natDegree default ((uniqueAlgEquiv R σ).symm f)
  exact True.intro
#print axioms directGenericLaw
#print axioms representationGap
end UniqueDegree162Composition
